description: This file defines the Xtensa-specific syscall interface for the Zephyr RTOS, including inline assembly functions for invoking syscalls with varying argument counts, and a helper for user context detection.

methods.name: xtensa_syscall_helper
methods.description: Helper function for performing Xtensa syscalls with up to 6 arguments.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke6
methods.description: Performs a syscall with 6 arguments using inline assembly or helper.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke0
methods.description: Performs a syscall with no arguments.

methods.name: arch_is_user_context
methods.description: Determines if the current thread is running in user mode.
